title: HubSpot CRM hygiene report
summary: Scans HubSpot contacts and companies for duplicates, missing fields, unowned and stale records, and writes a prioritised cleanup plan.
setup: Import the template and connect HubSpot.
Run it. It only reads from HubSpot and never changes a record.
Optionally set `stale_days` (default 180) for when a record counts as stale.
To get the report every week, add a weekly schedule to the playbook.
notes: Report only: it lists what to fix but does not merge, assign or update records.
Reads up to 2,000 contacts and 2,000 companies per run, in HubSpot's default order, so very large portals are only partly checked.
Duplicates are exact matches on email (contacts) and domain (companies), ignoring case and a leading www.
